scenes.headline: How Sol-Attn skips attention blocks mid-stream
scenes.sub: Training-free sparse attention for video diffusion, decided inside the kernel.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lychee! Video diffusion spends most of its time on attention. Here's how Sol-Attn skips most of it, with no training at all.

scenes.text: Decide which key blocks to skip inside the online-softmax pass the kernel already runs, using a threshold instead of a ranking.
scenes.mark: a threshold instead of a ranking
scenes.say: The idea: decide which blocks to skip inside the pass the kernel already runs, with a threshold instead of a ranking.

steps.label: every query tile meets every key tile
steps.say: Attention compares every query tile with every key tile. For a long video, that's the cost.

steps.label: top-k: the same count in every row
steps.note: 70.3% sparse on a peaked row and a flat one alike
steps.say: Top-k keeps a fixed fraction: seventy point three percent sparse on a peaked row and a flat one alike. It can't tell them apart.

steps.label: threshold at μ + βσ: adapts per row
steps.say: Sol-Attn keeps blocks scoring above the mean plus beta standard deviations. It adapts, but stays in a controlled band.

scenes.title: Route, compute and correct in one pass

steps.say: For each query tile, an outer loop mean-pools the key tiles into cheap proxy scores.

steps.note: a running mean and variance: no proxy map stored
steps.say: It compares them with the tile's threshold. A mean and a variance can be kept as a running summary, so no score map is ever stored.
Tiles above it get exact attention in the inner loop.
Tiles below aren't dropped. Their proxy scores, already paid for, approximate what they'd contribute. All in one online-softmax pass.

scenes.title: HunyuanVideo latency, techniques stacked
scenes.note: Sol-Attn's own share: 1.92x on top of the other two
scenes.say: The reported totals stack three techniques. On HunyuanVideo, Sol-Attn's own share, on top of fusion and step caching, is one point nine two times.

scenes.text: Ask where the information already is: a running statistic lets routing live inside the loop, and skipped blocks still count.
scenes.say: So ask where the information already is. A running statistic puts routing inside the loop, and skipped blocks still count.

recap: Threshold at μ + βσ instead of ranking blocks
Route, compute and correct in one pass
Skipped blocks approximated from their proxy scores
scenes.say: To recap: a threshold instead of a ranking, one pass instead of two, and skipped blocks approximated, not dropped.
